text:
maya (PM): quick sync on private deploy MVP: customers want stable egress IPs, an offline/slim installer, and KMS attestation. need clear launch criteria.

raj (Eng): egress stability is tricky across operator upgrades. we can do a best-effort controller for minor patches. operator-shim needed for determinism.

owen (Infra): shim idea: maintain ip handles and rebind on pod recreation. prototypeable, but adds control-plane coordination.

tess (Eng-Ops): prototype scope: shim POC + tests for minor upgrade path. can do Q2.

noah (Security): offline installer must support signed bundles, pinned pubkey, and an auditable attestation flow. loop legal early.

lina (Solutions): field asks: UI to specify allowed-egress CIDRs, install-only mode (no callbacks), and offline package docs.

maya (PM): proposed MVP criteria: 1) egress persistence for minor upgrades (best-effort) 2) offline installer with signed bundles 3) telemetry opt-in + local logs 4) KMS integration contract stub. agree?

raj (Eng): +1. note: enterprise SLA if they opt into shim behavior.

owen (Infra): add perf check: shim control-plane should not degrade token throughput >2%. will measure in canary.

deploy-bot: jira RED-3456 created: "operator-shim prototype" assigned to raj.

maya (PM): action items: - raj/tess: shim design PR by 2025-04-18 - raj/owen: offline-installer flags by 2025-04-25 - noah/lina: KMS draft by 2025-05-02 - maya: SLA baseline by 2025-05-09. will update roadmap sheet.

raj (Eng): will post a short RFC link here for review.
